title: rubus candicans subsp. adenophorus
intro: Rubus candicans subsp. adenophorus, commonly known as the Himalayan black raspberry, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the rose family. The Himalayan black raspberry is a type of bramble that has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its numerous health benefits. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating various health conditions, including digestive issues, fever, and skin problems. The bioactive constituents of the Himalayan black raspberry include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
